assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area polygons are provisional, derived from public boundary descriptions using agent-generated geometry. They are rough approximations and must not be used as official red lines, approval bases, or precise area references.
assumptions.impact: All area calculations, topology checks, and spatial analyses based on these polygons must be rerun when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Areas for site (11.4 km2), coordinated research (43.6 km2), and three key areas (192.1 + 104.3 + 72.0 ha) are derived from official announcement text descriptions. Exact polygon areas may differ after official release.
assumptions.impact: Area-based metrics (ratios, densities) are preliminary and subject to revision.

assumptions.statement: Road names and alignments in geometry/roads.geojson are used for spatial orientation and design discussion only. They do not represent official road centerlines, red lines, or engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: Traffic and slow-mobility design conclusions are conceptual and require official road planning confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, heights, and floor counts in geometry/buildings.geojson are conceptual design proposals, not surveyed existing conditions or approved construction documents.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classifications, FAR, and building density are design proposals pending official cadastral and control plan confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Phasing periods (2026-2030, 2031-2035, 2036-2040) are illustrative arrangements for design discussion. They do not represent approved implementation schedules, funding commitments, or government decisions.
assumptions.impact: Project timelines and investment plans must be confirmed by professional implementation studies.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap data is used only as background basemap context. It is not used for boundary, area, or alignment decisions. OSM attribution is included in sources.json.
assumptions.impact: No design decision relies on OSM positional accuracy.

assumptions.statement: Global AI innovation ecosystem case studies (King's Cross, Sophia Antipolis, Kendall Square, Tel Aviv, Tsukuba) are referenced for spatial principles and operation mechanisms. They are not direct spatial copies and do not imply endorsement by the referenced places.
assumptions.impact: Case study lessons are translated into local design principles, not imported as finished products.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, user personas, and operation mechanisms are design proposals. They do not represent approved technology deployments, procurement contracts, or service commitments.
assumptions.impact: Each scenario requires separate technology validation, privacy impact assessment, and commercial negotiation before implementation.

assumptions.statement: AI pilgrimage landmarks (Heritage Tower, Open Source Honor Wall, AI Governance Outlook) are conceptual designs. Their locations, forms, and contents require cultural heritage, urban design, and intellectual property reviews before implementation.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks are not approved construction projects; they are design proposals for professional deepening.

assumptions.statement: Annual event systems, developer community operations, and scenario opening mechanisms are proposals for professional deepening. They do not represent confirmed event schedules, operating budgets, or government approvals.
assumptions.impact: Operation plans require separate feasibility studies, stakeholder engagement, and funding confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Cultural narratives, signage systems, and international communication copies are design proposals. All historical facts, cultural references, and third-party IP must be verified and cleared before public use.
assumptions.impact: Cultural content accuracy and IP clearance are pending professional review.

assumptions.statement: All sources used in this proposal are registered in sources.json with authority levels, usability boundaries, and source types. Provisional and background-only sources are explicitly labeled and not upgraded to official status.
assumptions.impact: Source registry ensures traceability but does not guarantee accuracy of provisional or background data.
